title: How Did We Get Here?
summary: Trace the cultural and historical shifts that blurred the vision of manhood, name the cost of drift, and rediscover Scripture's direction for strength, responsibility, leadership, and legacy.

title: Wounds & Shame
summary: Separate guilt from shame, expose the wounds and secrets that isolate men, and begin defeating shame through grace, confession, brotherhood, and life in the light.

title: Father Figures
summary: Understand the father wound, the affirmation every son longs to receive, and the patterns father absence creates in identity, relationships, faith, and future generations.

title: Momma's Boy
summary: Examine the powerful mother-son bond without blame, recognize where protection becomes dependency, and make the physical and emotional break required for mature responsibility.

title: Finding Healing
summary: Move from hiding, posing, pretending, and self-protection toward honest healing through forgiveness, reconciliation, reordered family relationships, and courageous truth.

title: Biblical Manhood
summary: Reject a softened caricature of faith and look to Jesus as the model of masculine trust, truth, responsibility, courage, restraint, and spiritual authority.

title: Law vs. Grace
summary: Dismantle performance religion and the shame cycle it creates, then move from condemnation and legalism into grace, honesty, sonship, and relationship with God.

title: Obedience, Fear & Faith
summary: Distinguish healthy fear from fear-based obedience, confront procrastination and paralysis, and learn to act from intimacy, trust, and freedom with the Father.

title: Relationships and Rage
summary: Bring anger and its underlying pain into the light, reject both withdrawal and eruption, and practice honest, controlled action that repairs relationships instead of damaging them.

title: A Real Man
summary: Measure authentic masculinity against Jesus: trust the Father, reject passivity, speak truth, accept responsibility, lead courageously, and trust God for the reward.
